scope: Current applicability questions; accepted current-source economics and engineering evidence are retained separately.
scan_rule: Follow research/registry.json families[].research_questions and select status=pending_validation. Read current_evidence separately; a pending hypothesis does not invalidate an accepted bounded result.

current_evidence.boundary: Current Defense/Urgency and mechanism-ablation observations remain attached to F01 and their own frozen B0. They do not establish every temporal-permission, inventory-price or exposure-guard hypothesis. The current inventory-soft-control experiment is separate; no completed result is asserted here.

questions.question: What is the policy-level effect of retaining original VOL early recovery while removing only its waiting beyond the candidate's own natural B0 release?
questions.question_zh: 保留原VOL提前恢复、仅撤销本路径自然B0期限后的追加等待，会怎样改变完整账户结果？
gaps: Final was repeatedly used; this is not a fresh holdout or complete early-by-late factorial decomposition.
Range and release-to-first-request context require original causal event support; no extra model or economic arm is implied.
questions.next_validation: Complete original54 paired independent accounts against retained same-account VOL and versioned B0; report all outcomes, original blocks and event gaps without retuning.

questions.question: Does the actual spread-cap mode or its interaction with recovery, inventory role and outstanding orders explain adverse fills, and can a causal change preserve beneficial trading?
questions.question_zh: 实际价差cap模式及其与恢复准入、库存角色和在途订单的联动，是否影响不利成交；如何在保留有价值成交的同时改善风险？
gaps: Distinguish total ask-bid spread relative to mid from same-side/opposite-side BBO distance; distinguish compress, pause_exposure and observe modes.
Aggregate cap counters do not identify episode-to-request-to-order-to-fill causal attribution. Missing fields are not zero.
A cap hypothesis cannot be accepted merely from loss-selected dates; include all good/bad/mixed original accounts and unchanged baseline coverage.
Final is already observed. Do not tune thresholds or date filters on this diagnostic and claim fresh holdout validation.
questions.next_validation: First review actual frozen parameters and cap-hit/compression/exposure-block counters. Only if needed, propose parity-proven event observation linking rearm, cap, quote distance, order/cancel acknowledgements, inventory role and fills. New economic interventions need a separate approved plan.

questions.question: Does causal multi-timescale market context improve short-window rearm decisions after accounting for inventory direction, size, age and foregone repair?
questions.question_zh: 将短窗恢复与因果可见的多时间尺度振幅、波动和方向状态及库存联动，能否改善重新准入，而不是仅减少交易或错过修复？
gaps: Loss-selected cases cannot establish a population volatility-loss relation or causal benefit from a new policy.
Completed-day extrema and volatility are explanatory outcomes, not inputs available earlier that day; use only past visible rolling windows or the previous complete day.
Amplitude, signed price drift and realized volatility differ; missing one-second returns cannot be silently filled with zero.
Exact recovery-episode-to-order-to-fill linkage and cooldown duration distributions remain unavailable in the frozen worker.
questions.next_validation: Include profitable and losing accounts on matched coverage; define training-only references, causal clocks and missing-data treatment. Separately compare slow market context and inventory interaction without Final threshold tuning or hot-editing the current experiment. Any observation rerun must retain original results and prove economic parity.

questions.question: Can cooldown/rearm timing reduce adverse exposure without suppressing useful repair?
questions.question_zh: 冷却或重新准入的时机，能否减少不利敞口且不压制有价值的库存修复？
gaps: Historical near-noop or overbroad participation findings are hypotheses, not universal current failures; ongoing inventory-soft-control results are not complete evidence.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Separate one-cycle skips, until-flat restrictions, recovery-state and variance-time policies; compare total/unit net returns, participation and inventory on declared matched support.

questions.question: Can inventory-aware add prices, quantity limits or reducing aggression improve net value?
questions.question_zh: 库存相关的加仓价格、数量限制或减仓激进度能否改善净价值？
gaps: Lower inventory or faster repair does not itself identify the economic effect of the intervention.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Declare one intervention at a time; separate opener/add/reducing roles and full paths, accounting for delayed fills, terminal valuation and tail exposure.

questions.question: Does a decision-visible exposure guard select better risk rather than merely trade less?
questions.question_zh: 决策前可见的敞口过滤器，是改善风险选择还是仅减少交易？
gaps: Old q90/BER/ranked-toxicity outcomes have different identity and visibility limitations; no aggregate old ranking is current authority.
Bind the actual source, model, baseline, action semantics, accounting and previous-use; an old point estimate or closure label is not a current conclusion.
questions.next_validation: Bind ownership across inventory episodes and cancel acknowledgments; compare effective actions, matched participation controls and complete net accounting.
